title: Color Conditional Generation with Sliced Wasserstein Guidance
tldr_zh: 把可微 Sliced-1-Wasserstein 色彩距离注入扩散采样循环，training-free 实现颜色条件生成，色彩匹配优于先迁移流水线
tldr_en: Injects differentiable Sliced-1-Wasserstein color distance into diffusion sampling for training-free color-conditional generation
